target.title: fix(codex): align watchdog defer guards and add wall-clock ceiling (#99272)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Codex turn watchdogs are inconsistent about when they defer:

1. **Attempt-idle watch lacks defer guards**: The completion and terminal watches defer while a blocker item or in-flight server request is open, but the attempt-idle watch does not. A long quiet native tool call (e.g., `commandExecution` with buffered output) gets hard-aborted with `turn_progress_idle_timeout`.

2. **No wall-clock ceiling**: All four watchdogs are idle-based. A wedged turn that keeps emitting unrecognized notifications never times out at the harness level.

3. **Phantom blockers from out-of-order notifications**: If `item/completed` arrives before `item/started`, the late `item/started` adds a blocker id that nothing ever removes, suppressing completion/terminal watches for the rest of the turn.

4. **Unknown methods reset idle timers**: Every current-turn notification (including methods the projector doesn't handle) resets attempt-idle timers, so unrecognized notifications can prevent timeout indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **Attempt-idle + terminal watches**: Added the same defer guards (`getActiveAppServerTurnRequests() > 0` and `getActiveCompletionBlockerItemCount() > 0`) that the completion watch already has.
- **Wall-clock ceiling**: Added an absolute 60-minute wall-clock timer that fires regardless of activity, as the safety complement that makes deferring safe.
- **Blocker tracking**: `updateActiveCompletionBlockerItemIds` now accepts an optional `completedItemIds` set; late `item/started` for already-completed items is ignored.
- **Progress filtering**: Only dispatch-known notification methods count as attempt progress; unknown methods still touch completion activity but don't reset the attempt-idle watchdog.

## User Impact

- Legitimate long-running tool calls (builds, installs) are no longer aborted mid-execution.
- Wedged turns that emit only unrecognized notifications now terminate within 60 minutes instead of running forever.
- Out-of-order notification sequences no longer create phantom blockers.

## Evidence

- All 30 tests pass in `attempt-turn-watches.test.ts` (including 5 new tests)
- All 7 tests pass in `attempt-timeouts.test.ts`
- All 125 tests pass in `event-projector.test.ts`

Fixes #99272
